meta.name: Like Water for Chocolate
meta.description:
Tita de la Garza and Pedro Muzquiz are two souls in love who cannot be together due to deep-rooted family customs, which will force Tita to navigate with magical tints and flavors between the destiny dictated by her family and the fight for her love, while we accompany her in her greatest refuge: the kitchen.

Rated TV-MA · Ended · First aired 3 Nov 2024 · Mexico, United States of America · Language: Spanish
Studio: Ventanarosa, Endemol Shine Boomdog, Endemol Shine North America · Network: HBO Latin America, HBO Latino

Not complete. On your server: S1 6/6 | S2 not on server

videos.title: Cream-Soaked French Toast
videos.overview: After years apart, childhood sweethearts Tita and Pedro are reunited – but a deeply rooted family tradition rocks their plan to marry.

videos.title: Chabela Wedding Cake
videos.overview: Forced to help prepare for a wedding between her beloved and her sister, a heartbroken Tita throws her emotions into the cake, sparking Nacha’s memories of her own tragic love story with Miguel. Meanwhile, as trouble brews between his father and his friend Juan, Pedro chooses a side.

videos.title: Quail with Rose Petals
videos.overview: As the rebels continue their rise, Pedro commits himself to the Revolution, while Gertrudis makes a surprising move of her own. Meanwhile, now living in the same house, Tita and Pedro attempt to steal moments together under Rosaura’s watchful eye.

videos.title: Atole
videos.overview: While tending to a pregnant Rosaura, Tita learns of her sister’s unforgivable betrayal. But when their confrontation devolves into a frightening medical crisis, Tita is forced to put aside her feelings to help her sister. Meanwhile, Pedro finds himself in tricky situations with federal agents and his father.

videos.title: Turkey in Mole
videos.overview: As Rosaura struggles to bond with her son Roberto, Elena limits Tita’s access to him. Meanwhile, Gertrudis risks her safety to meet her nephew, and Elena is flooded with memories of her greatest love Treviño. As he fights for his freedom, Pedro makes a drastic decision that tears him away from his family and Tita.

videos.title: Northern-Style Chorizo
videos.overview: After Rosaura sends heartbreaking news to the family, Tita not only loses all desire to cook but finally finds the courage to stand up to her mother. Meanwhile, a vindictive Pedro leads Gertrudis and the rest of the revolutionaries into a battle with his uncle, and Elena seizes back her power – with devastating consequences.
